Subject: Request: Azure private SKU + co-sell terms (BluePeak)

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo last week. BluePeak is evaluating a private SKU via Azure Marketplace (we need VPC/private plan visibility for compliance). Procurement asked me to get commercial and co-sell details so we can baseline budget and internal approvals. Specifically: 

- One-time onboarding fee?
- Monthly committed spend for private SKU (min / recommended)?
- Suggested co-sell revenue split (standard vs negotiated for enterprise listings)?
- Billing flow: Microsoft resale (Marketplace) vs direct invoicing to BluePeak (PO preferred)
- Standard SLA & any exceptions for private plans
- Timeline for getting the private listing live in marketplace once contracts are signed

Attached: BluePeak_PO_Template_20270401.pdf (procurement asks to see if Redwood can accept PO net-45 and a limited set of terms).

Can you share the term sheet and the internal co-sell matrix you typically use? We'll need this for the procurement review scheduled 4/6.

Best,
Ava

Subject: Re: Request: Azure private SKU + co-sell terms (BluePeak)

Hi Ava — thanks for the clear list. Appreciate the PO template.

Short answers up front: no standard one-time onboarding fee for Private SKUs (we roll expected onboarding work into the first-month commitment), recommended committed monthly spend varies by model family (for enterprise-grade LLMs we typically see $25k-$150k/mo); we can be flexible on initial commit for a short ramp window. Co-sell splits are negotiable and usually sit in a band (20-30%) for partner-sourced opportunities when Microsoft marketplace co-sell applies; we can propose a 25% revenue share as a starting position and escalate to a 30% rate for ARR commitments > $500k.

Regarding billing: Azure private plans can be set up for Microsoft billing (marketplace resale) or as a direct invoiced private contract. If procurement needs PO + net-45, we can accept that under an enterprise amendment but that will require finance sign-off (we typically default to net-30).

I've attached a draft term sheet for the private plan that covers: commercial rates, rollback/fallback model variants, SLA language, and a co-sell matrix. I'll loop in Marissa and Laura to coordinate the marketplace ops and legal redlines.

Next steps: 
- I'll share the Draft_Azure_PrivatePlan_TermSheet_20270330.pdf now.
- Can you confirm the contact in your legal/procurement team who will sign the amendment?
- If Microsoft co-sell is required, we will also need to engage the Azure Marketplace PM to align listing timeline (usually 2-4 weeks after DocuSign and technical onboarding).

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor

Hi Ava / team — looping in Laura (marketplace ops) and Rafael (enterprise sales lead) to accelerate. A couple of clarifications from our side: 

- Co-sell eligibility: to get the marketplace co-sell routing the offer must meet minimum listing artifacts (SLA, security attestation, support contact). Laura can confirm the checklist but we can fast-track if BluePeak can sign the amendment quickly.
- Revenue attribution & partner split: we can provisionally agree to 25% for the first contract year and re-evaluate at renewal; if BluePeak wants 30% for the life of the deal we will need an EPD approval.
- Billing path: if the PO + net-45 is a hard requirement, finance will require a short credit review and a purchase order flow; expect an extra 5-7 business days.

Laura — can you confirm the fastest achievable marketplace listing date if paperwork is signed by 4/5? Also, can we accept BluePeak's PO template as-is or do we need to insert additional terms?

Ava — cc'ing azurepm@microsoft.com to open the co-sell ticket; Azure PM, any guidance on timeline or required artifacts is appreciated.

Hi BluePeak procurement,

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the SOW — very helpful. Quick responses to your asks: 

- Payment terms: We can accept PO + Net-45 for this one-off under an enterprise amendment; finance will issue an invoice with the PO number to AP@bluepeak.ai. Please allow an additional 5 business days for credit check clearance.
- Liability cap: We can reduce to 3x fees for the initial contract term (one year) with a cap of $2M as requested; will flag for legal sign-off but this is acceptable as an exception.
- Data residency: We can lock logs/telemetry to the US region for this private plan. We'll include a data residency appendix.
- SLA credits: Redwood's standard SLA gives service credits on a sliding scale; we can add an explicit clause for a single outage >30m at 10% credit.

Next steps: 
1) I'll incorporate these agreed points into a redline of the Draft_Azure_PrivatePlan_TermSheet and send a DocuSign envelope with the enterprise amendment and the marketplace listing addendum.
2) Rafael — can you confirm whether the provisional co-sell split of 25% is acceptable to the revenue ops team for BluePeak's expected ARR?
3) Azure PM — once DocuSign is complete, what's the earliest private listing activation window? We need to coordinate technical onboarding and listing artifacts; target: live by 4/20 if sign-off completes this week.

Ava / BluePeak — can you confirm who on your side will be signing the amendment (name + email) so I can pre-populate DocuSign?

I'll send the redlined term sheet within a few hours.

Best,
